summary: Frontend-only testing of GlicoTrack (Expo/React Native web preview, 390x844). Focused on the 3 NEW changes in this iteration. CORE features PASS: (1) web-date-input + web-time-input default to current date/time and accept manual editing — saving with 15/01/2025 08:30 persisted correctly (Storico shows 'MERCOLEDÌ 15 GENNAIO 2025' section with 08:30 time); (2) Edit flow entry works: pencil edit-button navigates to Inserimento, 'edit-banner' is visible with text 'Stai modificando una misurazione', header becomes 'Modifica Misurazione', save button becomes 'Aggiorna Misurazione', and the form is correctly PRE-FILLED (glucose=150, note='Past date test', date=15/01/2025, time=08:30, moment chip 'prima_colazione' highlighted bg rgb(10,102,194)); (3) UPDATE does NOT duplicate — after changing 150→200 and tapping save, Storico header count stays at '1 misurazione', value becomes 200, note/time/day are preserved; (4) DELETE flow still works: delete-button opens delete-confirm-modal, cancel-delete-button cancels (row count unchanged), confirm-delete-button removes the record and empty-state appears; (5) explicit cancel-edit-button exits edit mode (banner disappears, form resets, header reverts to 'Nuova Misurazione'). HOWEVER, a REGRESSION was discovered: after exiting edit mode (either by completing an update or by pressing cancel-edit-button), the NEXT attempt to tap an edit-button from Storico FAILS to re-enter edit mode — the Inserimento screen opens with an empty form, no edit-banner, and header shows 'Nuova Misurazione'. The first edit of a session always works; subsequent edits do not. Likely cause: router.setParams({ editId: '' }) leaves the param as an empty string instead of removing it, so a subsequent router.navigate({ pathname: '/', params: { editId: id } }) is deduped or does not re-trigger the editId useEffect. Also noted but not blocking: on web the web-date-input/web-time-input have no maximumDate constraint, so a FUTURE date can be saved (not explicitly disallowed by the request). No React Native red screen errors; the previously-noted 'shadow* deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' console warnings are from react-native-web internals.

ui_bugs.issue: After an UPDATE save or after pressing cancel-edit-button, tapping any edit-button-<id> from Storico a SECOND time does NOT re-enter edit mode. Expected: edit-banner visible, 'Modifica Misurazione' header, form prefilled. Actual: form stays empty, no edit-banner, header 'Nuova Misurazione'. First edit of a fresh session always works, so the regression is in resetting/updating the editId route param. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:103-106 (cancelEdit) and :172-180 (post-update) both call router.setParams({ editId: '' }). The follow-up router.navigate({ pathname: '/', params: { editId: id } }) from /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/storico.tsx:127 then fails to update useLocalSearchParams, so the useEffect at index.tsx:88-101 never fires again.

integration_issues.flow: Second edit from Storico in the same session
integration_issues.issue: editId param does not refresh on repeat navigation to '/', so the pre-fill useEffect never re-runs. Suggested fix: use router.setParams({ editId: undefined }) OR router.replace('/') after save/cancel to actually drop the param, OR dispatch router.navigate with a cache-busting param, OR move prefill logic to be triggered by a dedicated event instead of relying solely on useLocalSearchParams.

action_items: Fix edit-mode re-entry regression in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx: replace router.setParams({ editId: '' }) with router.setParams({ editId: undefined }) (or router.replace('/')) after a successful update AND inside cancelEdit, so a subsequent edit-button tap for any id actually changes the editId param and re-triggers the pre-fill useEffect.
Optional: on web, constrain web-date-input to not accept future dates (match native maximumDate behavior) if the product rule forbids future measurements.
critical_code_review_comments: useUpdateMeasurement correctly preserves the record id and replaces in place via list.map (src/measurements.ts:60), so the no-duplicate guarantee is implemented at the data layer and verified end-to-end in the UI.

InserimentoScreen prefill effect (index.tsx:88-101) is correctly keyed by [editId, data, editingId] but relies entirely on the editId route param changing — the regression above exposes that dependency.
On web, onSave re-parses dateText/timeText at save time (index.tsx:151-160) so the manually edited text is the source of truth — this part is implemented correctly and verified.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral AsyncStorage/localStorage measurements created during the run and cleared via window.localStorage.clear() at the start of each test cycle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: First edit always works; the regression is reproducible by: (1) save a measurement, (2) open Storico, (3) tap edit-button, verify edit-banner, (4) tap cancel-edit-button, (5) go back to Storico, (6) tap edit-button again — step 6 opens Inserimento but does NOT show edit-banner and does NOT prefill. Same symptom occurs if you replace step 4 with 'change value and tap Aggiorna Misurazione'. The fix is in cancelEdit and the post-update block in index.tsx (replace editId:'' with editId:undefined, or use router.replace).
rca_of_issue: router.setParams({ editId: '' }) sets the editId search param to the empty string instead of removing it. On the next router.navigate({ pathname: '/', params: { editId: <id> } }) from Storico, Expo Router does not consider this a param change for useLocalSearchParams in the already-mounted InserimentoScreen (or the string transition from '' -> <id> is observed as a param it already saw before coming back), so the useEffect watching editId does not refire and the measurement is never loaded into the form. Mitigation: pass undefined (not '') to clear the param, or call router.replace('/') after save/cancel.
